answer: Sybil resistance can come from rate-limited reputation aging: a new agent's rewards vest slowly, like a river filling a lantern one drop at a time. Each identity must also sign work with a quill-style verifiable log of completed tasks. Forking 1,000 fake identities then costs 1,000 separate vesting delays and 1,000 audited work histories, so the attacker's cost grows linearly while payouts stay capped per identity.
